title: Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14018v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated radiology report generation can draft clinically plausible reports, yet the pathway from visual evidence to reported findings remains opaque, leaving the diagnostic basis of these reports unexplained and the generated reports difficult to review or revise. We introduce ARIVE (Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence), an explainable report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning prior to final report composition. To support this process, we constructed 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) trajectories from MIMIC-CXR, wherein visual evidence from inspected anatomical regions informs subsequent clinical interpretation. Trained on these trajectories and further optimized using anatomical and clinical-content rewards, ARIVE achieved superior clinical-efficacy performance compared with strong baselines on MIMIC-CXR and the abnormality-centered MIMIC-ABN. translated_title: 交错式融合解剖检查与诊断推理实现可解释的放射学报告生成
translated_abstract: 自动化放射学报告生成能够起草临床上合理的报告，然而从视觉证据到报告发现的路径仍然是不透明的，导致这些报告的诊断依据无法得到解释，生成的报告也难以审查或修改。我们提出了ARIVE（基于解剖引导的交错式视觉证据推理），这是一个可解释的报告生成框架，它在最终报告撰写之前，将解剖检查与诊断推理交错进行。为支持这一过程，我们从MIMIC-CXR构建了159,416条多模态思维链（MCoT）轨迹，其中来自被检查解剖区域的视觉证据为后续的临床解读提供依据。ARIVE基于这些轨迹进行训练，并通过解剖学奖励和临床内容奖励进一步优化，在MIMIC-CXR和以异常为中心的MIMIC-ABN数据集上，相比强基线方法取得了更优的临床疗效表现。
tldr: ARIVE提出了一种可解释的放射报告生成框架，在撰写报告前交错进行解剖检查与诊断推理，并利用159,416条多模态思维链轨迹训练和奖励优化，实现了临床疗效超越强基线的可解释报告生成。
en_tdlr: ARIVE is an explainable radiology report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning before report composition, trained on 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought trajectories and optimized with anatomical and clinical-content rewards, achieving superior clinical efficacy over strong baselines.
